mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcements WHERE is_active = 1 AND (school_id = #{schoolId} OR school_id IS NULL) AND (start_at IS NULL OR start_at <= NOW()) AND (end_at IS NULL OR end_at >= NOW()) ORDER BY is_important DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM announcements WHERE is_active = 1 AND (school_id = #{schoolId} OR school_id IS NULL) AND (start_at IS NULL OR start_at <= NOW()) AND (end_at IS NULL OR end_at >= NOW())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcements (school_id, author_id, title, content, is_important, target_role, img_url, start_at, end_at, view_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{schoolId}, #{authorId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isImportant}, #{targetRole}, #{imgUrl}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, 0, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE announcements SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_important = #{isImportant}, target_role = #{targetRole}, img_url = #{imgUrl}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId}
UPDATE announcements SET is_active = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId}
UPDATE announcements SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE announcement_id = #{announcementId}
